summary: Builds output RGBA channels from weighted mixes of input RGBA channels plus per-channel constants.

key_params.name: red
key_params.note: Input RGBA weights used to build output red

key_params.name: green
key_params.note: Input RGBA weights used to build output green

key_params.name: blue
key_params.note: Input RGBA weights used to build output blue

key_params.name: alpha
key_params.note: Input RGBA weights used to build output alpha

common_gotchas: Weights are ordered by input R, G, B, A columns; they are not preset names.
Negative or large weights can produce values outside normal display range.
Constants can cause downstream clipping when output stays in low-precision formats.
Alpha is mixed independently and must be routed intentionally.
key_concepts: Channel Mix TOP is a matrix-style RGBA channel mixer.
Each output channel has four weights for input red, green, blue, and alpha.
Defaults pass input channels through unchanged.
Negative weights subtract channel values and can push results outside the 0-1 range.
Reorder TOP is the simpler choice for pure channel rearrangement.
